english: Heeey, isn't there something\nyou should be saying?
Say what?
I mean, we helped you out and everything,\nand you've failed at every single thing so far, haven't you?
Considering your results to date,\nwe are forced to judge your mission execution capability\nas deficient.
Maybe an apology\nwould be in order~
Alternatively, we demand\nyou present a concrete mission execution plan.
You're out of chances~?
I understand my position.\nI don't intend to make excuses.
Well, we could just\ntoss you aside, you know~!
Yi Wu is our collaborator.\nBut not our friend.
A cooperative relationship without results cannot exist.\nWe have not yet received sufficient return\nfor the information and technology we provided.
Doesn't Yi Wu have anyone stronger?\nSurely there must be someone, right?
I would like the results of the next operation\nto answer that question.
Fine.\nBut we're not helping you, okay?\nAnd we won't let Yi Wu help you either.
...You're telling me to do it alone?
If you won with our help now,\nthat'd be super uncool, right?
We expect a good report.
...Understood.
(So this is effectively an ultimatum...)
Mission: abduct Furude Rika.\nIts success is the minimum condition\nfor continuing our relationship with Yi Wu.
Furude Rika's power\nis worth that much.
Off you go!\nHope you make it back!
Hmph... they don't even intend to watch, it seems.
Not even worth watching, is that it?\nTo be looked down on this much...
If they hadn't forced that wasteful\nbrute-force strategy on me,\nI'd have results to show long ago...!
I have no need of Yi Wu's support.\nI'll devise a winning plan with the cards I have.
I'll show them what I'm really made of...!
//Scene change.\n//Background: IS Academy.\n//The group arrives at the academy.
We've arrived at IS Academy!
IS Academy is as beautiful as ever.
Huh? What's wrong, Houki-chan?
No... just feeling a little nostalgic.
It's not like that much time has passed?
It's not so much the time...\nI suppose you could say I'm relieved\nthe familiar places haven't changed.
I understand.\nHaving a place to come home to is wonderful!
Whether I can call this a place I should return to,\nI can't say.\nBut... it's true that I feel that way.
I got sent flying on my first day after transferring,\nso nothing feels familiar yet.\nBut I kinda get what Houki means.
I see...
What are you talking about?\nSleeping in your own bed-\nthere's nothing more wonderful!
Well, you do\ncarry your favorite pillow around with you.
Perhaps happiness is when such little things\naren't special,\nbut simply everyday.
The pilot is part of the IS too.\nWe need to rest up properly, not just maintain our IS units,\nto prepare for what's next.
Medical check before you relax.\nHand your IS over to maintenance, then head to the infirmary.
Oh right.\nThe medical check is like,\na full physical, right?
Wha- no way!?\nI can't sleep in my own bed tonight!?
According to the schedule, that's right.
Nooo! How dreadful!
You all go on ahead.\nI'll hand the Akatsubaki over to my sister.
Houki-chan, you should thank your sister properly.
...I'll try.
Okay.
//Fade to black, time passes.\n//Background: IS Academy.
Houki-san and the others are resting,\nso what shall we do?
Resting sounds nice,\nbut it also feels a little wasteful.
Wanna train? Hiyah!
At your pace\neveryone'll be worn out!
Wanna go out somewhere?\nThings have been tense lately-\nI could use a change of pace!
Really, I'm mentally exhausted.
(I feel like Usada-chan hasn't changed a bit,\nanytime or anywhere...)
I'd like to go shopping.\nIt's a good chance to restock\nfood and daily necessities.
Then I'll come too!\nIt's a fine opportunity to broaden my horizons.
If Satoko's going, then I am too.
Hauu~ I wonder if there's anything cute? I wonder?
If we head into town,\nthere might be something Rena'd like.\nI'm gonna hunt for momoman!
The momoman was delicious!\nI'll come along too!
So I don't have to go do the shopping?
You're the bag carrier!
Yes...
(Maybe my treatment's improved a little?)
Shirayuki's coming too.
Huh? But I...
No need to hold back.\nIsn't there something you'd like to try?
W-well, there is... is it okay to say it...?
What is it? Tell us!
Wanting to meditate under a waterfall,\nor go exorcise a haunted spot-\nnone of that, okay!
No!\nI, um, want to try a crepe... I said it!?
You wanna try a crepe?\nYou've suddenly let loose!?
Hauuuuu!! Crepes are great!\nThey're tasty! Right, right!
You can take those home, you know.
Yattaaaa! Takeout!!
We can all eat them together,\nso I think that's fine.
Naturally, we'll make one with mustard in it\nand play Russian crepe, right?
I can only see a future\nwhere I'm the one who gets it...
(That's the tasty part!\nGet a laugh there while aiming\nfor the slightly-pitied position.)
(Position... what do you mean...)
...Someone bring Aoi here!
Ahaha!\nAoi-chan loves spicy stuff, after all!
...Wait, Houki-chan? What's wrong!?
What about your medical check?
The thing is, my sister said she didn't want to leave it to the academy-\nshe'd do it herself...\nI begged off and ran away.
Is that all right?
My sister's a mad scientist.\nUnder the guise of a medical check,\nthere's no telling what she'd do to me!
Surely she wouldn't go that far?\nTo her own little sister...
If she were the kind of sister\nI could believe that about, I wouldn't be this afraid.
Well, you're obviously healthy,\nso who needs a check anyway!
True, Houki trains every morning at the crack of dawn-\nshe doesn't even have time to get unhealthy.
More importantly, you're going out to have fun, right?\nBetter to have someone\nwho can guide you around.
That would help.\nI still don't really know\nwhich shops sell what.
Of course, of course.\nThen let's head\nsomewhere we can shop, shall we.
Hmm, I wonder\nwhen you became such a thoughtful person.
Don't be rude!\nI know at least that much!
Enough fooling around-\nlet's head out.
Satoko's right. Let's move out!
I'm looking forward to it, mii! Nipah~!
//Screen fades to black.
This is the biggest shopping mall nearby.\nYou can get most things here.
Ah! So many nice things!\nI have to be careful not to buy too much!
Where are the crepes? I wonder?
Everyone has shopping to do,\nso let's have an hour of free time,\nthen meet back here for crepes.
I agree!
I agree too!
An hour? That'll be gone\njust trying on clothes.
It takes that long?
It really shows your personality.\nSome people decide in a flash,\nothers just can't choose.
Then disperse! Meet back here in one hour.
Yeah!
//Fade to black, time passes.\n//Background: town.
Mii~.\nThere's so much I've never seen before~.
Is it okay to go off on your own, away from Satoko?
Satoko went with Aria\nto a shop with suspicious machine parts.
Believe it or not, Satoko has a timid side too,\nand she wants to overcome it.
It wouldn't be good\nfor me or Shion to always be by her side.
I see.
By the way, Houki, why are you\nfollowing me around this whole time?
There've been more crimes targeting kids lately,\nso it's dangerous out there.\nAnd besides...
If someone's being targeted, it's me, isn't it?
...I thought saying that would ruin\nthis nice time we have,\nso I didn't mention it.
I appreciate the concern.\nBut that's something\nI'm well aware of myself.
I see.\nHonestly, you're not very childlike.\nNo wonder you're a handful.
...Mii?
All right! I'll free you from that\nunchildlike-ness!\nLet's go!
Mii!?\nPlease don't pull me~.
//The fake Houki approaches Rika. Shirayuki appears.
Wait!
Hm?
Shirayuki...?
Where do you intend to take Rika-chan?
It's decided, obviously.\nA very special place I know.\nWant to come too, Shirayuki?
Mii?
That is... Yi Wu, isn't it!
//Event CG: Shirayuki readying her kusarigama (reuse if possible).
Shirayuki?
Let go of Rika-chan's hand!\nIf you're really Houki-san, you can do that, right?
Stop joking around!\nThe Akatsubaki is in maintenance-I can't use it!
I see... that's why you chose now\nto impersonate Houki-san.\nBecause nobody would suspect you even if you can't deploy an IS!
Mii!
//Event CG off.
...When did you figure it out?
When you said you ran away from your sister.
You seemed to know a lot\nabout Houki-san and her sister's relationship,\nbut you didn't know about the change in Houki-san's feelings.
Everything else was perfect.\nThat's exactly why that part stood out...!
Hmm... it seems my estimation was\nnot wrong.\nYou are excellent, Hoshitogi Shirayuki.
But you understand, don't you?\nI am touching Furude Rika.\nIf you move carelessly...
//Houki changes into Jeanne.
In an instant, Furude Rika's arm will freeze and shatter.
Jeanne d'Arc...!
Follow me.\nThe moment you take any action disadvantageous to me,\nFurude Rika will become a pitiable sight.
Shirayuki... please run...
...Don't worry, Rika-chan.\nIt'll be all right...!
//Battle map: forest.\n//Rika (immobilized) beside Jeanne, Shirayuki nearby. Allies arrive later as reinforcements.
This place will do.
What are you going to do with Rika-chan!
Hand her over to the client.
...That Mii and Kei, you mean.
They seem quite interested in Furude Rika's power.
But taking her to Yi Wu\nand studying her at leisure would be interesting too.
Study... did you say...!
Whichever hands she falls into,\nshe'll be a research subject either way.\nSo the question is which...
Apologize!!
What?
Interesting? "Research"...?\nDon't mess with me! Apologize to Rika-chan!
You can't escape the power you were born with,\nor the fate that comes with it.\nYou know that well yourself, don't you?
That's...!
A power no ordinary person can possess.\nNow that its existence is known,\nliving without being targeted is impossible.
Pity can't save anyone.
I brought you here\nbecause I recognized that you do\nhave the makings to come to Yi Wu.
Follow me, Shirayuki.\nLearn and hone your power, and you will become a shining gem.
Jeanne...!!
There's nothing to be torn about.
Rika-chan...?
You just need to fight and win, Shirayuki.\nI'm the princess waiting to be rescued.\nNipah~!
Jesting, in this situation...
I won't run or hide.\nIf Shirayuki loses,\nI'll quietly go with you.
But if you fight with me as your hostage,\nI'll throw my life away for Shirayuki.\nAnd Shirayuki won't stop fighting until she dies.
Rika-chan... that's not okay!!
Shirayuki... you mustn't run\nfrom fate, from your power.\nI...
I've decided to fight alongside you all.
If you don't want to go home empty-handed,\njust fight Shirayuki and make her surrender.\nCan you do that?
Foolish... Hoshitogi Shirayuki has neither\nthe strength nor the resolve to fight me...
I do!\nAccept my duel, Jeanne d'Arc!
...Very well.\nThe word duel carries weight, you know?
I believe I understand... more than you do!
Wait for me, Rika-chan!\nI'll definitely win!
//Battle begins.\n//Allied reinforcements after several turns.\n//But Aria appears later, so she can't be deployed yet.
Rika-san! Shirayuki-san!
Everyone!
Sheesh, no wonder you weren't coming back!
I'll save you now! Hang on!
For the boors who would spoil a duel,\nI'll give them this.
//Enemy reinforcements. Grunts deployed en masse to keep allies from approaching Jeanne and Shirayuki.
Ngh, there's so many!!
What the hell!
That'll do. Now, let us continue!
Just what I wanted!
//Kei appears near Jeanne.
Ah!
Wh!? What did you come here for!?
Warning: mission has a critical error.\nRequesting correction.
//A strong grunt appears near Shirayuki.
You! You'd defile a duel!!
Duel: incomprehensible.\nRecognized as an obstacle to mission execution.
//Kei vanishes.
Don't screw with me!!
Huh, first time\nI've seen you get emotional.
That voice!?
//Aria appears.
I was hiding, planning to snatch Rika\nwhen I saw an opening, but that's not the situation here.
I'll punch a hole through this nuisance,\nso keep fighting your duel.
Okay...!
Kanzaki H. Aria... you have my thanks.
...Hmph.
//Event triggers when Jeanne is defeated.
Tch!
Jeanne, you can't run anymore... no,\nI've made it so you can't escape.
I never intended to run in the first place!
That's not it. Because from now on,\nyou will witness the forbidden demon arts\nhidden within the Hoshitogi shrine maidens.
What...?
I... no, we Hoshitogi shrine maidens have inherited\nthe founder's power and name\nacross nearly 2000 long years.
Shirayuki is a cover name to hide my true name.\nMy imina... my real name is...
Himiko.
//An effect of Shirayuki turning red, or something-if that's too hard, don't worry about it.
Flames!? Flames on the blade!?
Jeanne, that sword of yours... I'll cut it down!
//Would it look unnatural in the art\nto use the battle skill Hihi no Hotogigami here? If so, let's not use it.
Hoshitogi Souten style:\n"Hihi no Hotogigami"!!
//Play a booming sound, flash the screen, then show the event CG.
That's... impossible...!?\nDurandal was shattered...!?
Will you... continue...?
//Event CG off.
Demonic sword Durandal, you're under arrest!
I won't resist.
Perhaps I underestimated\nHoshitogi Shirayuki until the very end.
Butei Law Article 9: a Butei cannot kill.\nThat's why Shirayuki couldn't\ndeal me a fatal blow.
I fought with the resolve to never admit defeat, even if killed-\nI couldn't possibly lose to someone with no killing intent.\nAnd yet it ended like this.
Haa, haa, haa...
//Shirayuki collapses (sound effect).
Shirayuki-san! Are you all right!
My strength... is all... gone...
But there's one thing I don't understand.\nSetting aside the power of the forbidden demon arts,\nhow could you fight me to a standstill when I far surpass you in combat experience?
Jeanne.
Rika! I've cuffed her,\nbut don't get close!
It's fine,\nI'd like to have a little chat with her, just the two of us.\nNipah~!
//Fade to black, time passes.\n//Background: town.
What did you want to talk about?
Shirayuki's fast asleep,\nso I'll explain in her place.
//Event CG: Dark Rika speaks.
Listen, 30th-generation Jeanne d'Arc.
You have passed through 30 generations\nover 600 years... and for one-sixth of that-100 years-\nI have repeated death, remaining myself. Do you believe me?
What do you mean...?
You must know a little\nabout Hinamizawa.\nThe loop is triggered by my death.
What did you say...!?
I've repeated death, accumulating 100 years.\nI've lost count of how many times.
This power to turn back time...\nit's not something you can use at will...?
I have no proof. But Shirayuki believed me.\nAnd... feeling its weight,\nshe cried for me.
Because she too bears the weight\nof over 2000 years of Hoshitogi time.
The one you dueled\nwas no longer an unpolished gem bewildered by her power.\nSo you need not be ashamed of your defeat.
//Event CG off.
I think I understand why my holy sword was broken.\nAnd the secret of your strength,\nwhich puzzled me all along...
I see... good.
//Fade to black.\n//Background: in front of IS Academy.
Rika, what were you talking about with Jeanne?
She told me\nwhether escargot is really delicious~.
With a face like that, you're really a sly one.
Takes one to know one. Nipah~!
Yeah, yeah... anyway, we'll hand Jeanne over\nto the police via Butei High, so once the IS maintenance is done,\nwe're moving out.
Okay.\nWill Shirayuki be better by then?
No need to worry about that.\nA super-detective's power drains mental strength,\nbut once that recovers she's fine.
You of all people should know\nhow much mental training Shirayuki's done as a shrine maiden,\nRika.
Then I can rest easy.
//Fade to black.\n//Background: classroom.
The medical check's finally over.
Everyone's healthy, body and mind! No issues!\nWell, obviously!
The Akatsubaki's issues still aren't resolved?
Yeah, there's apparently no fixing\nthe poor energy efficiency for now.
The price of high performance, I guess.
For now we'll have to manage as-is.\nWhat of it-I just need to handle it well myself!
That's the most suspicious part...
Don't say it! ...Come to think of it, where's Cecilia?
Look, over there.
Hafuu... I'm sleep-deprived...
//END
